params.message: The Bank Teller has a point. The old man testified he heard the body fall and then got to his door in 15 seconds. But he has a stroke limp. Has anyone actually timed how long it takes a man with a limp to walk 40 feet to a door? It doesn't quite add up, does it?

The Stockbroker calls the woman's account 'reliable.' But didn't she testify she saw it through the last two windows of a passing el-train? And hasn't anyone noticed the marks on the side of her nose? The same marks many of us have from wearing heavy glasses? If she wasn't wearing them in bed, how clearly did she actually see a stabbing through a moving train at night?
